title: From Prompt to Recommendation: A Fitted Stage Model of Brand Visibility in AI Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.23162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We analyze 34,960 unbranded prompt-engine observations from 75 anonymized Aiso projects, covering 2,854 distinct monitored prompts and repeated GPT and Gemini runs from June-September 2026. When neither the target brand nor its own domain appears in the observable live retrieval path, target mention rates are 2.8% for GPT and 3.8% for Gemini. With an own-domain citation but no branded fan-out, they rise to 49.0% and 58.4%. When both own-domain exposure and a branded fan-out occur, mention rates reach 91.4% and 100%.   The relationship persists within the same project, prompt, and engine across repeated runs: among prompt cells that vary in own-domain exposure while holding branded fan-out absent, exposure is associated with a mean mention-rate increase of 40.2 percentage points on GPT and 49.0 points on Gemini. Prior visibility is independently persistent. A previous non-mention plus no current own-domain exposure yields next-run mention

translated_title: 从提示词到推荐：AI搜索中品牌可见度的拟合阶段模型
translated_abstract: 我们分析了来自75个匿名Aiso项目的34,960条无品牌提示词-引擎观测数据，涵盖2,854个不同的受监控提示词，以及2026年6月至9月期间GPT和Gemini的多次运行结果。当目标品牌及其自有域名均未出现在可观察的实时检索路径中时，目标品牌的提及率在GPT上为2.8%，在Gemini上为3.8%。当存在自有域名引用但无品牌化扇出时，提及率分别上升至49.0%和58.4%。当自有域名曝光与品牌化扇出同时出现时，提及率分别达到91.4%和100%。这一关系在同一项目、同一提示词和同一引擎的重复运行中持续存在：在品牌化扇出不出现、而自有域名曝光存在变化的提示词单元中，曝光与GPT上平均40.2个百分点、Gemini上平均49.0个百分点的提及率提升相关。先前的可见度具有独立的持续性。前一次未被提及且当前没有自有域名曝光时，下一次运行的提及……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于34,960条AI搜索观测数据，揭示了品牌在AI搜索可见度中的阶段性递增规律——品牌提及率随着自有域名被引用和品牌化扇出的出现，从个位数（2.8%-3.8%）逐步攀升至接近100%。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 34,960 prompt-engine observations from GPT and Gemini, this paper fits a stage model of brand visibility in AI search, showing that mention rates climb from 2.8-3.8% with no brand exposure to 91.4-100% when both own-domain citations and branded fan-out occur.
